observations.observation: Original hero is a full-width saturated blue block (~680px tall) with an animated network/constellation pattern, likely canvas-driven; AI-built hero sits on the pale grey-blue page background (rgb(247,248,252)) with no decorative pattern and no animation, ending around y≈425.

tags.value: changed: full-bleed blue animated pattern becomes plain pale hero

observations.observation: Both pages have a single centered H1 in the hero. Original sets it in white uppercase Montserrat at 32px/600 ('INSTANTLY ANALYZE YOUR SEO ISSUES') on blue; AI-built sets it in dark navy system-ui at 51.2px/700 in sentence case ('Get an instant analysis of your SEO problems').

tags.value: changed: red uppercase h1 becomes white sentence-case h1

observations.observation: The AI-built H1 highlights the phrase 'your SEO problems' with an em rendered in the accent blue; the original H1 has no highlighted phrase.

tags.value: added: accent blue highlighted phrase in h1

observations.observation: Tagline under the H1: original uses an italic Lora serif h2 in Title Case (22px/500); AI-built uses a two-line grey sans-serif paragraph about 620px wide.

tags.value: changed: italic serif h2 becomes grey sans paragraph

observations.observation: Hero action: original has a single URL input form with a flat square-cornered green 'REVIEW' button (rgb(105,203,149), radius 0, with a search icon); AI-built has no input and instead shows two anchor CTAs, a solid blue 'Analyze your site' (rgb(56,86,224), 8px radius, 12px 24px padding) and an outlined blue ghost button (0 button elements).

tags.value: changed: url input with green button becomes blue and ghost anchor buttons
changed: hero url input form

observations.observation: Both pages show sample links to h-supertools, booksandmore and L-ink under the hero action. Original shows them as small, low-contrast blue text links on the blue hero; AI-built shows them as pill-shaped chips beside a small blue letter-spaced 'REVIEW' label.

tags.value: changed: text link line becomes icon chips

observations.observation: Both headers have a 'Seo Analyzer' wordmark, Home and Site vs Site links, and an EN language control on the right. Original places them on the blue hero with a white leaf logo and globe icon; AI-built uses a slim 61px white bar with a two-colour wordmark ('Seo' navy, 'Analyzer' blue) and a bordered EN chip.

tags.value: changed: nav on blue hero becomes slim white bar
changed: white leaf logo becomes two-tone text wordmark

observations.observation: Both have a three-column feature row (Unlimited Analysis, In-Depth Reviews, Competitive Analysis). Original puts centered columns with no cards on a pale grey band; AI-built uses equal white bordered cards (333x244) with left-aligned text, introduced by a 'Features' h2 and subtitle.

tags.value: changed: uncarded centered columns become bordered white cards

observations.observation: Feature icons: original uses blue FontAwesome glyphs (chart, server, thumbs up) in white circular badges; AI-built uses emoji or symbols (∞, 🔍, ⚖) in 40x40 grey-lavender rounded-square tiles. Neither uses SVG.

tags.value: changed: icon fonts in circles become emoji in rounded tiles

observations.observation: Body text: original is 14px/24px Helvetica Neue in dark grey rgb(51,51,51), centered in the features; AI-built is 16px/25.6px system-ui in navy rgb(27,32,51), with grey rgb(91,99,121) secondary text, mostly left-aligned.

tags.attribute: body text size and line height
tags.value: changed: 14px 1.7 becomes 16px 1.6
changed: dark grey text becomes navy with grey secondary

observations.observation: The section header for recent sites differs. Original uses a bar with a darker blue label block holding a leaf icon and 'Recently Listed' (h4), plus a small cyan 'View More →' button on the right. AI-built uses a bold 'Recently listed sites' h2 with a grey subtitle and puts a centered outlined 'View More' button below the grid.

tags.value: changed: icon label bar becomes bold h2 with subtitle
changed: right small button becomes centered outlined button below

observations.observation: Both pages show recently listed sites as a 3-column, 2-row grid of cards. Each card has a 600x450 screenshot, a domain name and stats. Original cards have a thin border and padding around the image, with blue link-style names below. AI-built cards are bordered, rounded article elements with the image flush to the top edge and the domain as a bold h3 link.

tags.value: changed: padded bordered images become rounded cards with flush image

observations.observation: Both cards end with three stats: Score N/100, Global Rank and Page Speed %. Each shows a bold value with a small label. Original uses an inline strip with uppercase labels; AI-built uses separate light-grey rounded tiles (rgb(227,230,240)) with sentence-case labels built from b and small elements.

tags.value: changed: inline stat strip becomes separate stat tiles

observations.observation: AI-built colour-codes score values (green, amber, red); original shows score values without status colouring.

tags.value: added: green amber red score coloring

observations.observation: Both pages show zero-value stats such as 'Global rank 0' and 'Page speed 0%', rendered the same way as real values.

tags.value: kept: zero values rendered like real values

observations.observation: Card alignment: on the original, long domain names wrap and push the stat strips out of line, so cards in a row have unequal heights. AI-built cards are a fixed 333x392 with names that fit, so they stay aligned.

tags.value: changed: uneven card heights become equal height cards

observations.observation: The portal.oouagoiwoye.edu.ng card has no preview. On the original, a broken image icon shows its alt text in a 215x32 box. AI-built uses a full-size 331x249 lavender placeholder div reading 'No preview' (5 images versus 6).

tags.value: changed: broken thumbnail becomes no preview placeholder

observations.observation: Both pages show uncontrolled third-party site screenshots that vary widely, including a captcha, a black page with raw links, a washed-out truck photo and faded thumbnails.

tags.value: kept: varied uncontrolled site screenshots

observations.observation: Both pages have images with alt text and no missing alts. Original alts equal the domain names; AI-built alts follow 'Screenshot of <domain>'.

tags.value: changed: domain alts become screenshot of domain alts

observations.observation: Footer: original has a dark slate-blue (rgb(60,71,100)) three-column block (About Us, Contact Info, Navigation) with uppercase white h2 titles, short underlines and vertical dividers. AI-built has a slim footer on the pale page background with only copyright text on the left and social icons on the right.

tags.value: changed: dark three-column footer becomes slim copyright footer

observations.observation: About us and Contact are separate content sections in the AI-built page, each with an h2 in a full-width band. About us is a 720px-measure left-aligned paragraph on white, and Contact is a dt/dd description list. In the original, these appear as footer columns.

tags.value: changed: footer columns become separate about and contact sections
changed: footer column becomes full-width about band

observations.observation: Social icons: original uses green FontAwesome glyphs (Facebook, Twitter, Google+, LinkedIn) inside rotated-square diamond outlines; AI-built uses four 32px circular spans with text letters (f, t, in, ig).

tags.value: changed: diamond icon glyphs become circular letter badges

observations.observation: Contact info shows the address 'SE Lawnfield Rd' and the email support@h-educate.com. Original shows them with green icons and an orphan phone icon with no number. AI-built shows them as labelled Address and Email rows, with the email as an underlined blue link.

tags.value: changed: plain text lines become dl with labels and email link

observations.observation: Both pages credit the copyright to H-educate in 2020, which differs from the Seo Analyzer brand ('Copyright © 2020. H-educate All rights reserved.' versus 'Copyright © 2020, H-educate. All rights reserved.').

tags.value: kept: copyright line

observations.observation: Palette: original uses several accents (saturated blue, mint green, cyan, slate navy, social green rgb(58,195,65)) on white or light grey, with Bootstrap link blue rgb(51,122,183). AI-built uses a single royal-blue accent rgb(56,86,224) on a near-white blue-grey background with navy text, and amber, green and red only for scores.

tags.value: changed: multi-accent palette becomes single royal blue accent

observations.observation: Font families: original mixes Helvetica Neue, Open Sans, Montserrat and Lora, plus FontAwesome and Glyphicons icon fonts. AI-built uses only the system-ui stack, with hierarchy from size and weight (h1 51.2px, h2 28.8px/700 against the original's h2 22px/500).

tags.value: changed: helvetica neue becomes system-ui stack
changed: icon fonts for social and ui glyphs

observations.observation: Corner rounding: original is almost entirely square (274 at 0, 16 at 1–7px, none at 8px or more, 3 pill, and a 0px-radius primary button). AI-built rounds cards, tiles and buttons at 8–15px (33 elements) and uses 7 pills.

tags.value: changed: square corners become small rounding and pills

observations.observation: Neither page uses gradients or backdrop blur. Original has 4 box shadows, 66 transitions, 1 animation and 8 transforms. AI-built has 0 shadows, transitions, animations and transforms.

tags.value: changed: many transitions become fewer transitions

observations.observation: Layout technique and width: original uses floats or a Bootstrap-style grid (0 grid, 0 flex) with content about 1140px wide (x 150–1290). AI-built uses CSS grid on 17 elements and flex on 6, in a 1040px column (x 200–1240). Both are on a 1440px canvas.

tags.value: changed: floats and fixed widths become flex plus grid
changed: 1140px column becomes 1040px column

observations.observation: Semantic markup: original is div-heavy (92 divs) with no header, main or article, 1 section, 2 navs and 1 footer. AI-built has header, nav, main, 4 sections, 6 articles and a footer, with 51 divs.

tags.value: changed: divs become header nav main sections articles

observations.observation: Heading outline: original has h1, then h2, then h4s that skip h3, with footer h2s and an empty h4. AI-built has h1, 4 h2s and 9 h3s in order. Both have one H1 and four H2s.

tags.value: changed: flat irregular outline becomes structured h1 h2 h3

observations.observation: Page size and copy length: original has about 204 words and is 2399px tall; AI-built has about 258 words and is 2646px tall. Neither uses exclamation marks or em dashes.

tags.value: changed: shorter page becomes slightly taller page

observations.observation: Head metadata: original has description, keywords, author and og: tags, with no lang attribute and the title 'Seo Analyzer'. AI-built has only charset, viewport and description, with lang 'en' and the title 'Seo Analyzer – Instant analysis of your SEO problems'. Neither has JSON-LD.

tags.value: changed: rich social meta becomes minimal meta

observations.observation: Resource loading: original loads 15 scripts and 8 stylesheets and has 24 inline style attributes. AI-built has 1 script, 0 external stylesheets, a single style block and 2 inline style attributes.

tags.value: changed: many scripts and stylesheets become single inline style

observations.observation: Both use semantic or bespoke class names rather than utility classes (Tailwind-like fraction 0.008 versus 0.028). The vocabulary differs in size: 111 unique classes from 250 uses on the original, 28 from 71 on AI-built.

tags.value: kept: custom class names rather than utility classes

observations.observation: The original DOM includes 3 forms (the hero search plus hidden sign-in and sign-up forms) with 11 inputs and 8 buttons. AI-built has no forms, inputs or button elements.

tags.value: dropped: search forms and sign-in inputs

observations.observation: Text case: original uses uppercase for the H1, section and footer headings and card labels, and Title Case for the tagline and features. AI-built uses sentence case for headings and labels, apart from the small caps 'REVIEW' label.

tags.value: changed: all-caps headings become sentence case headings

observations.observation: Navigation is minimal on both: header links Home and Site vs Site. The original adds a footer Navigation column with a single HOME link; the AI-built footer has no navigation links.

tags.value: changed: minimal header links
changed: footer navigation column

observations.observation: Both pages use generous vertical whitespace between full-width bands that alternate white and grey backgrounds, separated by thin rules.

tags.value: kept: alternating white and grey bands
kept: generous vertical whitespace

observations.observation: Alignment: original centers the hero and the feature text. AI-built centers only the hero and left-aligns headings and body in the sections below.

tags.value: changed: centered content becomes left-aligned sections

observations.observation: Copy voice: the AI-built page uses short feature-and-benefit marketing text with generic claims such as 'thousands of small-business owners'.

tags.value: added: generic marketing benefit claims

observations.observation: ARIA usage is light on both pages: 7 attributes on the original and 6 on AI-built.

tags.value: kept: light aria usage
